text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, clerk. Those large white beans 
and the fresh milk—

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Oho, little lady! You've got quite an eye 
to single out our white kidney beans!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I heard that you carry exceptionally 
high-quality goods here.
choice_data_list: Is it really that much of a favorite?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! It's not really my favorite 
food, but... I need it to make 
"Grandmother's Shiruko."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
When I was little and stuck in bed with a 
cold, my grandmother would often make me 
pure white oshiruko.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A gentle warmth I can still remember when 
I close my eyes... I wanted to recreate 
that taste myself.
choice_data_list: I'd like to try some too.
I want to try some too

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-You will, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I don't mind, but, um... well, hmm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: N-No! That's not the case at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This is a rare opportunity to introduce 
you to the Mejiro family's culinary 
tastes. I shall pull out all the stops to 
prepare a feast for you...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We were also able to borrow the cafeteria 
kitchen. Everything is ready. Now—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
P-Please wait a moment! Um, if I recall 
Grandmother's teachings correctly—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Beans! First, you have to simmer the 
beans! I remember completely now...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...U-Um, Trainer-san. May I ask you a 
question――"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: To "simmer"... what exactly should I do?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: N-No! You see! This is, well... uuugh...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. I apologize, I must confess. I 
am still very much in training when it 
comes to cooking—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I am not confident I can properly recreate 
that memorable flavor.
choice_data_list: In that case, I'll help out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Really? After saying I'd treat you, it 
feels a bit awkward, but... yes, please!

“—First, I gave an explanation on what it 
actually means to 'simmer' something.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“—I see, I understand completely. Simmer 
gently over low heat, right? Leave it to 
me!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...By the way. Just how much heat is 'low 
heat' supposed to be?

And so, although Mejiro McQueen struggled 
with the unfamiliar cooking—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's done! This sweet aroma of milk... 
Hehe, it's just like I remember from my 
childhood!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Yes, of course. After all, it is to 
recreate Grandmother's flavor.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Besides... it's all thanks to your 
cooperation, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, please have the first bite. 
It's a token of my gratitude. Come, while 
it's still warm.
choice_data_list: Let's take our time and eat together.
Drink it all in one gulp.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Grandmother once told me something 
similar long ago.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"If we eat together, you won't even notice 
the cold." And truthfully, back then, it 
really did make me forget the misery of 
being sick.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A painful illness turned into a fond 
memory— Keeping that in mind too, it's a 
taste full of memories.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this time together with you, Trainer. 
Well then—itadakimasu!

The pure white oshiruko I ate together 
with Mejiro McQueen tasted extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
All at once like that! Please be very 
careful not to burn yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really? ...Fufu, I'm so glad. I'm not 
too used to cooking, so that's a huge 
relief.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"...Because a new memory with you has now 
been added to this taste."

And that was how our first cooking session 
with Mejiro McQueen somehow turned out to 
be a success.
